market.question: Will Trump agree to Iranian oil sanction relief by May 31?

assessment.reasoning: Trump administration on March 20, 2026 already lifted sanctions on 140M barrels of Iranian crude already loaded onto vessels and issued waivers. This appears to satisfy 'reduce' or 'waive' sanctions per market wording. However ambiguity exists on whether partial waivers qualify as 'definitive agreement' to reduce sanctions. Resolution risk on interpretation.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether the March waiver counts as 'definitive agreement' under market rules.
